blocks.content: Write a program to remove elements from a set.

items: Get string input and store it in the key variable.
Initialize a string set called languages with the elements C++, Python, Swift, and Java.
Use the erase() function to remove the key from the set.
Print languages again in a new line.

blocks.content: Assumption: The user will only enter valid keys.

Expected OutputC++, Java, Python, Swift, 
C++, Python, Swift,
